lines.speaker: crew_exec_1
lines.text: Hale pulled the Lab B variance sheet off the shared drive.
lines.direction: low office voice, leaning slightly toward his colleague

lines.speaker: crew_exec_3
lines.text: Since when? It was up at seven.
lines.direction: quiet surprise, glancing toward the hall

lines.speaker: crew_exec_1
lines.text: Right after he got off the line with topside.

lines.speaker: crew_exec_3
lines.text: Great. So we just pretend we never saw the pressure chart.

lines.speaker: crew_exec_3
lines.text: Did you see Halcyon's departure window moved up forty-eight hours?

lines.speaker: crew_exec_1
lines.text: Without telling crew rotation?

lines.speaker: crew_exec_3
lines.text: Cargo priority only. Nobody's rotating off this run.

lines.speaker: crew_exec_1
lines.text: Keep your voice down. Wait till the galley hears that.

lines.speaker: crew_board_1
lines.text: Until Lab B clears containment, nothing goes in the topside brief.
lines.direction: measured corporate authority across a conference table

lines.speaker: crew_board_2
lines.text: If the East Corridor seal fails, withholding a log is a regulatory breach.

lines.speaker: crew_board_3
lines.text: Voss hasn't checked in since midnight. That's not a paperwork problem.

lines.speaker: crew_board_1
lines.text: Director Hale is reviewing it personally. Next item on the agenda.

lines.speaker: crew_board_4
lines.text: Every hour the launch trunk stays idle costs us forty thousand.

lines.speaker: crew_board_3
lines.text: And pulling another core sample before we know what's in column four is madness.

lines.speaker: crew_board_2
lines.text: Let's note a forty-eight hour review window in the minutes. Nothing stronger.

lines.speaker: crew_board_4
lines.text: Fine. Just keep security out of the manifest.

lines.speaker: crew_admin_visitor
lines.text: My badge still shows pending for East Wing. I have samples waiting.
lines.direction: mildly frustrated, standing at the reception desk

lines.speaker: crew_assistant
lines.text: I'm sorry, all East Corridor clearances are paused during the routine audit.

lines.speaker: crew_admin_visitor
lines.text: Nobody audits a wet lab by locking the techs out.

lines.speaker: crew_assistant
lines.text: I can put your name on Director Hale's callback list.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_1
lines.text: Return line's running three degrees warm again. Check the manifold?
lines.direction: practical shop talk over the grow troughs

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_2
lines.text: Checked it twice. And there's a dark film in the catch screen.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_1
lines.text: Algae bloom? We just bleached the tanks Monday.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_2
lines.text: It isn't green. I'm logging a flush before lunch.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_2
lines.text: Smell the kettle in the storeroom this morning?

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_1
lines.text: Somebody's been sleeping on a cot in there all week. Thought it was maintenance.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_2
lines.text: Maintenance doesn't have a Level Two keycard.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_1
lines.text: Long as they don't touch the basil, I didn't see anything.

lines.speaker: crew_diver_1
lines.text: Something brushed the ROV tether at four hundred metres last night.

lines.speaker: crew_maint
lines.text: Current's been weird by the trench lip. Probably kelp or drift cable.

lines.speaker: crew_diver_1
lines.text: Drift cable doesn't leave groove marks in braided steel.

lines.speaker: crew_maint
lines.text: Then write it on the inspection board. I'm already behind on the winch.

lines.speaker: crew_maint
lines.text: Breaker down the back corridor tripped twice again before shift change.

lines.speaker: crew_diver_1
lines.text: Same feed that runs the trunk floodlights?

lines.speaker: crew_maint
lines.text: No, just the corridor relay. Ops closed my ticket without sending anybody.

lines.speaker: crew_diver_1
lines.text: Classic TAG. Give 'em a flashlight and call it a retrofit.

lines.speaker: crew_exec_2
lines.text: Yeah, hold the cold-chain manifest for Lab B until Hale signs off.
lines.direction: quiet, speaking into a desk phone

lines.speaker: crew_exec_2
lines.text: No, I don't have an ETA either. Just keep the bay slot open.
lines.direction: tired corporate phone voice, wrapping up the call

lines.speaker: crew_exec_4
lines.text: I sent the gasket requisition Tuesday—yes, the pressure-rated ones.
lines.direction: hushed, brisk on a desk phone

lines.speaker: crew_exec_4
lines.text: Fine, flag it urgent and put my name on it. Thanks.

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_3
lines.text: Tray six, seventy-two percent germination... still fogging on the south glass.
lines.direction: softly muttering to herself while taking notes

lines.speaker: crew_botanist_3
lines.text: At least the heirloom starters don't seem to mind the heat.

lines.speaker: crew_diver_2
lines.text: Core four, minus eighty, seal intact... still missing the Lab B return slip.
lines.direction: quietly reading off a clipboard in a cold storeroom

lines.speaker: crew_diver_2
lines.text: Swear those lab folks think crates walk back here on their own.

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Halcyon's manifest is two crates short again. Same story every rotation.
lines.direction: quiet dry mutter to himself at the security desk

lines.speaker: crew_dock_guard
lines.text: Three hours till galley lunch... better not be powdered eggs twice in one day.
